sections.title: Meet *Kim Brinson*

image.alt: Kim Brinson, smiling, in a navy top outdoors

body: Kim is a licensed health and life insurance agent and consultant in South Carolina, with 27 years in the health insurance field. She helps with group health, individual health, life insurance and disability, and puts your needs first so you can make a wise decision. Away from work she loves the lake, the beach, and time with her family and grandchildren.

Mark Taylor Insurance was started with one idea: serve our customers first. Rules, regulations and technology have changed over 40 years, but our mission hasn’t: the best insurance and the best service possible, from people who live here.

items.q: Will you sell my information to call centers?
items.a: Never. We won’t send you spam or give your information to marketing organizations. We’re a South Carolina agency with local employees.

items.q: Does my insurance cost more through you?
items.a: No. Major medical plan prices are set by the marketplace. We’re paid a commission by the insurance company you enroll with.

items.q: What is a major medical plan?
items.a: Also called a Qualified Health Plan, it’s certified by the Healthcare.gov Marketplace to cover essential health benefits, limits cost-sharing, and covers pre-existing conditions. Beware of plans that don’t meet these requirements.

items.q: Can I enroll outside open enrollment?
items.a: After a qualifying life event, like losing coverage, marriage, a birth or adoption, or a move, you have 60 days to enroll in a new plan.
